text: Figure 10.1: Calibration Support Data attached to Implementation In general, MC support data shall be generated for all data with measurement or cali- bration access in modules or components. For the methodology , we have to distinguish two cases: • MC support data is generated by the RTE generator for those data, which are allocated also by the RTE (resp. the BSW Scheduler). For BSW modules, this means that those data need to be declared as BswInternalBehavior. emplate
